sam_support: Customer (acme-inc) reporting repeated 400 parse errors when calling our tool via JSON-mode. They say the model returned a function call, runtime rejects the tool args with "invalid JSON: expected object".

sam_support: Repro snippets from customer (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/call
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-internal-1",
  "json_mode": true,
  "input": "Summarize",
  "tool": "run_search",
  "tool_args": "{\"query\": \"payment failures\", \"filters\": \"status:failed\"}"
}
```

sam_support: Notice they passed tool_args as a string (escaped JSON) — our runtime expects a JSON object according to the declared function schema (`filters` is an array). Customer says SDK serialized nested JSON automatically and they didn't notice.

maria_sre: Can we get the request_id and the runtime log? customer's ticket: #54321. Any quick logs from ingress?

sam_support: Request id from customer: r-0145b3. Attached runtime excerpt:
```
[2026-06-02T15:12:05Z] request r-0145b3 POST /v1/call 400 parse_error
runtime: tool call validation failed: tool_args not object
parser: JSON parse failed at offset 34: unexpected token '\"' (received string)
```

jordan_infra: That stack trace matches an old strict-path in the JSON-mode deserializer that rejects stringified arg payloads. We recently changed streaming framing so some SDKs started sending tool_args as a string for nested JSON — bug introduced in reframe/stream-parser v2.1.0.

jordan_infra: Quick mitigation: tell customer to send `tool_args` as an object (not a serialized string). Example payload that works:
```json
{"tool": "run_search", "tool_args": {"query": "payment failures", "filters": ["status:failed"]}}
```

maria_sre: Do we want a temporary server-side tolerance (accept stringified JSON and attempt parse) while SDKs are patched? Customer is on Dedicated and hitting production traffic.

jordan_infra: I'll open infra ticket and add a compatibility layer that will attempt JSON.parse when `tool_args` is a string and schema expects object/array. Also add better error message. Tracked in GH#4821.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-06-02T15:20:00Z started by @jordan_infra (infra/compat-json-parse) :rocket:

sam_support: Thanks. I replied to customer with the workaround and asked them to switch `tool_args` to object form. Told them we're patching server-side and will update when deploy finishes. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: Follow-up: also include a note to SDK/DevEx to patch serializers — this will prevent recurrence. Adding to sprint.

sam_support: I'll keep thread updated. Closing customer loop once GH#4821 is merged and deployed.
